Captures are an ephemeral pre-triage inbox: they are converted into backlog items and goals (counted there) and emit no creation event of their own, so they carry no durable historical value to measure independently.

domains.reason: agent_activity is a live, derived view of in-flight agent-manager runs (a polling projection), not a persisted swarm-manager entity; it has no event-log presence and no countable historical rows.
graph holds structural/presentation node positions for the workspace canvas, not historical countable rows.
operations is a computed operations-briefing summary derived on read from other domains, not a persisted entity with its own rows.
plan is the Plan-lens board projection (dependency waves + next-action markers) computed on read from backlog/execution/capture state; it owns no persisted rows of its own.
scenario is a read-through catalog of the scenarios/ directory (configuration metadata), not swarm-manager-owned persisted state.
